projects.title: Human-in-the-Loop Approval System — Copilot Studio & n8n
projects.description: Enterprise approval automation built with Microsoft Copilot Studio and n8n. Requests raised via Copilot bot are auto-routed to the right approver — notified via Teams/Email, one-click approve or reject, decision logged automatically.

components.text: Copilot Studio collects approval requests conversationally and triggers an n8n workflow that routes to the correct manager, sends a Teams/Email notification with Approve/Reject action, and logs the outcome — fully automated with zero manual follow-up.
